title: SEG Waiver Node
description: Schema for a Waiver node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Created exclusively by the Functional Safety Manager to excuse a FAIL, ERROR, or SKIPPED test outcome. Sourced from repo G. Append-only and immutable once created — a superseded waiver is retired by creating a new waiver, never by editing the old one. Approver identity and approval timestamp are provenance metadata derived from git log in repo G at proof generation time and are not stored in the node content.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this waiver. Form: {namespaceBase}/waiver/WAV-{number}. Assigned manually by the Functional Safety Manager. Maps to spdxId on SPDX export.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. No direct SPDX equivalent. Maps to spdx:Annotation with annotationType review on SPDX export.

name.description: Human-readable waiver identifier. Must match the ID suffix in the id field.

seg:outcomeId.description: IRI reference to the TestOutcome node this waiver excuses. Must resolve to an existing TestOutcome node with outcome FAIL, ERROR, or SKIPPED. Cross-node validation is enforced at graph level, not schema level.

seg:justification.description: Human-readable explanation of why this test outcome is acceptable despite not passing. Should reference supporting evidence such as issue tracker entries, hardware test results, or engineering analysis.

seg:expiry.description: Optional ISO 8601 date after which this waiver is no longer valid. Recommended to force periodic re-examination of known failures. An expired waiver does not excuse the referenced outcome — the FSM must create a new waiver or resolve the underlying issue.

seg:nodeHash.description: Hash of all content fields in this node: name, outcomeId, justification, expiry (if present). Computed over content fields only — approver and approved_at are excluded as they are provenance metadata derived from git log. Participates in Merkle computation like any other node.

comment.description: Optional free-text note. Not part of the node content and not included in nodeHash computation.
